description: Node definitions for PCG Graph editors (mesh, spline, and Houdini-style attribute/filter nodes). Pin types align with UE EPCGDataType.

includeOnlyOnBoundary.displayName: Include Only Elements on the Boundary

includeAllPrimitivesSharingAttributeBoun.displayName: Include All Primitives Sharing Attribute Boundary Points

includeOnlyEntirelyContained.displayName: Include Only Elements Entirely Contained in Original Group

includeOnlyPrimitivesSharingEdge.displayName: Include Only Primitives Sharing an Edge with Original Group

allowAttributeOverride.displayName: Allow Primitive Attributes to Override Parameters

outputAsSubdivisionCurves.displayName: Output as Polygon Curves to be Subdivided Later

nodes.description: Smooth then RDP-simplify SpatialSpline outlines. protectSpans are input-point index closed intervals (not Groups). Defaults are no-op. Active processing canonicalizes an explicit duplicate closing point on closed splines. Does not resample, repair self-intersections, or convert to columns.

eps.description: Max point-to-segment distance kept by RDP. 0 disables simplification (no collinear collapse).

protectSpans.description: JSON array of {start,end} input-point index closed intervals. Protected points are not smoothed or deleted; indices refer to the input before closing-point canonicalization. Cross-seam (start>end) only on closed splines.

nodes.description: Welded solid from closed outline, columnsJson, or spine+edge stations. Select path with inputMode (no auto-detect). Prefer over micro-cylinder BooleanMesh chains for knife/plate bodies.

inputMode.description: Explicit input path. outline = closed spline extrusion; columnsJson = stations JSON; spineEdge = paired spine/edge polylines.

thickness.description: Full thickness (m). Outline mode default; also fallback half_z for column modes.

thicknessSamples.description: JSON array of full thickness per outline vertex (meters). Empty = use thickness.

rows.description: Interior rows for column loft (cosine-graded t). 0 → 1 band.

profileMode.description: zAt across t: constant, slab, blade.

edgeFrac.description: Thickness retained at outline edge for slab/blade roll (fraction of half_z).

useGroupsForBounds.displayName: Use Groups to Determine Justification Bounds

timeoutMs.description: 0 = no timeout. Best-effort wall-clock abort during intersection; returns observable error (or passthrough A).

onFailure.description: error = fail cook with message (cancel/timeout/budget). passthroughA = emit mesh A and continue (avoid silent hang).

radius.description: Practical min ~0.001 m. Sub-mm cutters for jimping/scallops via BooleanMesh are unstable — prefer OutlineSolid profile envelopes or larger cutters.

height.description: Practical min ~0.001 m. Avoid chaining tiny cylinders as the only micro-detail strategy.

scaleU.description: Deprecated for mirror: prefer flipping refMinU/refMaxU (crop SSOT). Negative retained for compatibility.

useReferenceBounds.description: When true, planar UV uses refMin/Max world crop (textureCrop SSOT) instead of mesh AABB.

refMinU.description: World-space min along projection U axis (e.g. X when direction=Z).

refMaxU.description: World-space max along projection U axis.

refMinV.description: World-space min along projection V axis (e.g. Y when direction=Z).

refMaxV.description: World-space max along projection V axis.

connectOnlyToOtherEndPoints.displayName: Connect Only To Other End Points

arcLengthU.displayName: Carve Curves by Relative Arc Length

cutAtAllInternalUBreakpoints.displayName: Cut At All Internal U Breakpoints

cutAtAllInternalVBreakpoints.displayName: Cut At All Internal V Breakpoints
